pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: Clear prices by service and square meters without hidden fees

office.name: Small Offices
features: Dusting furniture, shelves, and work surfaces
Vacuuming carpets and wet-mopping hard floors
Glass doors and interior partitions within reach
Disinfection of handles, switches, and railings

office.name: Medium Offices
features: Full small-office scope for larger floor areas
Meeting rooms and shared zones (tables, chairs, sideboards)
More frequent WC cleaning by agreement
Dedicated contact person and monthly reporting
Volume discount on the per-m² rate

office.name: Large Offices
features: Multi-floor cleaning with a coordinated team
Reporting and checklists for facility management
Key and security protocol aligned with building rules
Eco or standard products as agreed
Consumables and equipment for large areas on request

airbnb.name: 1 Bedroom Apartment
features: Bathroom and WC: ceramics, shower, sink, mirror
Kitchen: worktops, sink, hob and appliance fronts
Trash removal and tidying common areas
Bed linen change and bed making
Handover ready for the next guest

airbnb.name: 2-3 Bedroom Apartment
features: Everything from the smaller unit, extended to more rooms
More thorough dusting in bedrooms and corridors
Multiple bathrooms cleaned to the same standard
Kitchen including backsplash and cupboard fronts
Final check of lights, odours, and visible stains

airbnb.name: Large Apartments
features: Full cleaning of all living areas and bedrooms
All bathrooms and WC in full scope

furniture.name: Sofa Cleaning
features: Inspection of fabric type and stains
Armchair from 800 CZK, 2-seat from 1400 CZK, 3-seat from 1800 CZK
Safe products for colours and fibres

furniture.name: Carpet Cleaning
features: Disinfection suitable for households with children
Fringe and edge cleaning where applicable
Price 120 CZK/m² — final scope by inspection

furniture.name: Protection Treatment
features: From 400 CZK per piece by size

renovation.name: Rough Cleaning
features: Removal of coarse construction dust and debris
Preparation for painting or final phase
HEPA vacuuming in dust-sensitive areas on request
Handover of visibly passable rough state

renovation.name: Final Cleaning
features: Fine dust removal from walls, floors, and fittings
Thorough window and frame cleaning inside
Sanitary areas including joints and silicone
Ready for client handover or move-in

renovation.name: Complete Package
features: Rough clean plus final clean in one project
Regular site visits during construction by agreement
Dedicated team and single point of contact
Timeline aligned with your construction schedule
Custom scope: garages, cellars, outdoor areas
Price on inspection — no surprises in scope

development.name: Small Projects
features: Turnover cleaning for up to about 10 units
Removal of labels, dust, and light construction dirt
Windows and floors ready for takeover
Rate from 30 CZK/m² — exact figure after walkthrough

development.name: Medium Projects
features: Written reporting and snag lists on request
Uniform quality standard across all units

development.name: Large Projects
features: SLA and penalties defined in contract
Warehouse and common parts included by scope

buildings.name: Small Building
features: Entrance and glass at main doors
Light fixtures and railings within reach
Waste room and bin area basic cleaning

buildings.name: Medium Building
features: 3× per week or as agreed with HOA
Elevator cabins and machine room (exterior access)
Seasonal deep cleans of entrance zones
Simple reporting for SVJ / HOA board

buildings.name: Large Building
features: Dedicated staff familiar with the building
Parking and garage frontages by agreement
Price on request after site audit
